entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 43
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 300 of 2023
Petitioner :- Kuldeep Singh And 4 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Anand Kumar Prajapati

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned AGA for the State-respondents.

By means of the present writ petition the petitioners are seeking quashing of the First Information Report dated 29.06.2022, registered as Case Crime No. 0144 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323,
506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Daraganj, District Prayagraj with the further prayer not to arrest the petitioners pursuant to said FIR.

Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents points out that the charge-sheet no. 142 of 2022 has been filed on 25.10.2022 in the present case and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
